kind: Independent pinned Rust branch review for forthcoming intent refinement; no candidate Lean/kernel/native execution claim
source_behavior: ensure_ready enforces ready and every partition not poisoned before comparing actual roots and previous boundary
serialize failure happens before readiness change; intent-existing branch bounded-reads exact serialized bytes then returns success without height/history checks or write
intent-absent branch requires next height and absence of retained height record before setting ready=false
durable_write executes temporary create/truncate, write_all, file.sync_all, rename to intent path, then parent-directory sync; failure after rename can leave an intent file present
write error retains ready=false and permits callback-observed filesystem state; no inference of absent intent or disk rollback
successful durable write sets ready=true; it does not perform Store.commit/participants or select next boundary

existing-intent idempotence, serialization/writes, concrete path/20digit height formatting, byte encoding, maximum-record read and OS durability remain explicit native refinements for a functional model
